page.title: Mergesort
page.desc: Split, sort each half, merge; described by John von Neumann in 1945. Guaranteed O(n log n), stable, needs O(n) extra space.
page.intro: Split, sort each half, merge; described by John von Neumann in 1945. Guaranteed O(n log n), stable, needs O(n) extra space.

synapses.text: No bad inputs: the recursion depth and the work per level are fixed, which is why it suits linked lists and external sorting.

synapses.lead: The merge step is the whole trick
synapses.text: Merging two sorted sequences is linear; everything else is bookkeeping.
